name: Kairo Supply
description: Kairo Supply — a trade-account landing theme for an electrical wholesaler's trade counter. A white 176 px hairline grid with plus ticks, a giant ink KAIRO SUPPLY wordmark cut by both viewport edges with a stadium-shaped documentary photograph over it and one tagline spread across the full width; a tall egg photograph beside a large story; a blurred full-screen dark stage with a big list; outlined pills with a dot as the one repeated call to action. Inter Tight for headings, Hanken Grotesk for reading. Sample content in English first; the other four languages follow. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
